title: I had been collecting pieces into this playlist that I had initially labelled “noit vibes”, mixing n
content:
I had been collecting pieces into this playlist that I had initially labelled “noit vibes”, mixing night/noir and vibraphones together; pieces that have the b^w cinematic jazz feel of the 60s. After Debora’s invitation, I’ve tried to get a coherent 60 min mix out of them. Hope you enjoy it. I’ve made the rest of them into a spotify playlist. https://ift.tt/33Cihss

Originally released on Worldwide.fm, thanks to Debora Ipekel.
https://ift.tt/32rr5kI

title: Conceived in Berlin during November 2016Mixed in January 2017.A little travelogue with a lot of free
content:
Conceived in Berlin during November 2016
Mixed in January 2017.
A little travelogue with a lot of free jazz & ambient and electronic music, what the city & the weather was conveying to me at the time. A little bit more claustrophobic and demanding than usual undomondo mixes - bec of hey, Berlin! - but I hope you enjoy it nonetheless.

Trying to return to a more content state of mind in these extremely turbulent times, I fell back on music again. Just finished this show which is the signature Undomondo sound blending, jazz, exotica, OST’s, from all over. title: Undomondo Radio 159
content:
Undomondo Radio 159

In October this year, I made my overseas debut in NYC, the capital of the world, as far as we know. Although the city is portrayed as a rough, tough and unforgiving city, I actually found it welcoming and hospitable. This mix is influenced by life in NYC, and New York artists, I think I might have managed to contain the feeling of walking through the streets of NYC in a musical narration.

Unfortunately SC scrapped my opening piece by Basquiat’s Gray.
